api_doc_gaps.detail: srs.md A4 RULE-FILE-003 and the SVC-API Error Catalog specify AES/GCM, ~100m TTL, and single-use, but no key length, key-derivation, or token wire-encoding; db-script.md has no crypto detail and DATA-DOM.md only restates the rule. Implemented a minimal defensible choice (SHA-256-derived 256-bit AES key, 12-byte GCM IV, 128-bit tag, Base64URL(IV||ciphertext) payload of fileId+expiry+16-byte nonce).
api_doc_gaps.resolution: RESOLVED (STEP 2, existing-source + intent): the access token is opaque to clients (issued by API-FILE-002, returned verbatim on API-FILE-003) — its byte layout is a purely internal implementation detail, not an external API contract, so no SRS/db-script value governs it and there is nothing to agree cross-repo. Confirmed no pre-existing AES/GCM utility elsewhere in the codebase to mirror. The agent's choice (SHA-256-derived 256-bit AES key from file.access-token.secret, 12-byte GCM IV, 128-bit tag, Base64URL(IV||ciphertext) over fileId+expiry+nonce) is cryptographically sound and self-consistent; kept as-is. Entry retained as historical record.

api_doc_gaps.detail: The module's artifacts publish ERR-0004 FILE_DOCUMENT_OWNERSHIP_REQUIRED, but the code is structurally unreachable over HTTP. UploadRequest carries @NotBlank on the ownership fields (ownerType, moduleCode), so Spring bean validation refuses the multipart bind at the controller boundary and GlobalExceptionHandler.handleValidation answers 400 / VALIDATION_ERROR with fieldErrors[{field: moduleCode}] before the domain ownership guard — the throw site of ERR-0004 — is entered. UploadRequest's own javadoc already calls the ownership triple 'mandatory structural validation for RULE-FILE-005 (ERR-0004)'. Verified against the running app 2026-09-12: an upload omitting moduleCode returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR naming moduleCode. The rule IS enforced; only the published code is unobservable. TC-BE-FILE-009 was corrected to assert the real contract (400, VALIDATION_ERROR, fieldErrors naming moduleCode).
api_doc_gaps.resolution: OPEN — human decision required: either (a) relax the @NotBlank bean validation on UploadRequest's ownership fields so the domain rule owns the refusal and ERR-0004 becomes reachable (losing handleValidation's per-field detail and its report-all-failures-at-once behaviour), or (b) strike ERR-0004 from FILE's error catalog and state in the artifacts that RULE-FILE-005 is enforced structurally at the DTO layer. No error-catalog file was edited by this entry.

api_doc_gaps.endpoint: API REGISTRY in P3_1/backend-execution-plan.md — written as prose, so no served FILE endpoint can be stamped with its API-FILE id
api_doc_gaps.detail: Found 2026-09-23 by the api-doc generator's new `check` mode (contract-ids: 0/12 endpoints stamped; the plan has an API REGISTRY heading but no row the extractor can read). Same shape as NOTIF's registry: several entries per line, `CRUD` in place of a verb, no unambiguous verb+path pair. FILE's published api-docs therefore carry no Contract ID line and no drift table. The generator will not guess an id from prose. Remedy is the factory's: rewrite the registry as a table with one row per endpoint (id | operation | verb | path). Nothing in this repo was changed for this entry.
api_doc_gaps.resolution: OPEN — factory owns the plan; `check` fails contract-ids for FILE until the table exists

api_doc_gaps.endpoint: DELETE /api/v1/files/{id} (API-FILE-006) — FileService.softDelete carried no @PreAuthorize (SEC-PENDING TODO) although V9/V31 register and grant PERM_FILE_BROWSER_UPDATE / _DELETE
api_doc_gaps.detail: Surfaced 2026-09-23 as the one FILE endpoint whose generated page read `Authorization: no @PreAuthorize/@Secured declared — checked FileController.archiveOrDelete and FileService.softDelete`. V31's header and PermissionConstants' FILE comment both recorded the gap as 'one annotation cannot express two permissions chosen by argument'. It can: SpEL reads the method argument. Fixed in this repo: PERM_FILE_BROWSER_UPDATE and PERM_FILE_BROWSER_DELETE are now declared in PermissionConstants (values identical to the V9/V31 rows), and FileService.softDelete carries @PreAuthorize requiring UPDATE when #action is ARCHIVE and DELETE when it is DELETE; any other action value passes the gate unchanged so the service's existing FILE_DOCUMENT_INVALID_TRANSITION 400 still answers it (the gate never turns a malformed action into a 403). SEC-BE.md's matrix already names both cells, so no artifact change is needed there; V31's comment is an applied migration and stays as history.
api_doc_gaps.resolution: IMPLEMENTED — gate and constants added 2026-09-23; the SEC-BE matrix row was already correct
